event_chain.summary: E-visa platform breached, method not disclosed
Applicant data stolen and leaked online

summary: In November 2025 unidentified hackers breached Somalia's newly launched electronic visa / E-TAS travel authorisation platform run by the Immigration and Citizenship Agency, exposing personal data of at least 35,000 applicants including US and UK citizens (names, photos, dates of birth, marital status, home addresses, email addresses). Leaked documents circulated online; the US and UK embassies issued warnings, the agency shut the platform down, a national investigative committee was formed and the agency's deputy director was dismissed.
